warnings.warning: Eq.1-Eq.12 lack complete units and calibrated state values for ATP, CP, lactate, oxygen, and conversion efficiencies.
The coupled glycolysis-aerobic system uses symbols and caps whose initial values and numerical update rules are incomplete.
Figure 4's branch controller does not fully specify simultaneous depletion, restoration, or nonnegative-state safeguards.
Eq.13 uses ground speed in baseline aerodynamic drag, while wind-relative speed is introduced only later.
Eq.17 has a v=0 singularity and the motion solve omits braking and numerical integration details.
Eq.20-Eq.22 do not document the exact lean/friction geometry or wet-road calibration.
The fixed-speed optimality argument compares an incompletely defined class of strategies and does not solve a full optimal-control problem.
Eq.24-Eq.29 have an unclear wind sign convention and no independent vector-aerodynamic validation.
The 75 percent drafting coefficient is not calibrated by spacing, rider order, yaw, or a primary source.
Eq.32 has ambiguous indices, units, distance closure, and objective; the optimizer and feasibility checks are absent.
Eq.4 is inconsistent with Eq.3: the printed expression uses remaining CP content where integrating the depletion equation requires consumed content M_CP-V_CP(t).
Eq.23 leaves a and f insufficiently tied to prior parameters and cannot establish constant speed as globally optimal; Section 10.1.2 itself concedes the strategy analysis is incomplete.
Eq.24 and Eq.30-Eq.31 use mu in the mechanical power balance even though Eq.17 defines drivetrain efficiency eta and Eq.1 reserves mu for ATP-energy conversion.
Expanding Eq.26 over a turn indicates Eq.28 should contain vx^2+vy^2 rather than vx^2-vy^2, and Eq.29 omits the mean 0.5(vx^2+vy^2) term.
